Team Star, the Delinquents!!]]''. At [[West Province (Area One)]], two Grunts attempted to recruit [[Penny]] into their ranks despite her repeated refusal. Overhearing the commotion, {{Violet}} stepped in to defend Penny, eventually defeating the Grunts with his {{p|Fuecoco}}. The Grunts fled, promising to inform their boss of what happened. In ''[[PASV04|Raid! The Dark Crew Base!!]]'', [[Cassiopeia]] contacted Violet and {{adv|Arven}} and recruited them as members of Operation Starfall, a plan to force Team Star to disband by defeating each of its five bosses. Overhearing this conversation, [[Clavell]] decided to also participate after disguising himself as a student named Clive. {{-}} ====Segin Squad==== [[File:Team Star Segin Squad Adventures.png|thumb|250px|Members of the Segin Squad in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] In ''[[PASV04|Raid! The Dark Crew Base!!]]'', Violet, Arven, and Clive traveled to the [[Segin Squad's Base]] to raid it. There, a pair of Grunts informed them about the Star Barrage. In [[PASV05|the following chapter]], Violet and Arven battled many Grunts in the Star Barrage, but only Violet managed to defeat the required number of Pokémon before the time limit expired. None of their moves are known.}} ====Schedar Squad==== [[File:Team Star Schedar Squad Adventures.png|thumb|300px|Members of the Schedar Squad in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] In [[PASV14]], while traveling through [[East Province (Area One)]], Violet was attacked by several Grunts. Though he managed to win, the sheer number of opponents left his Pokémon too exhausted to continue fighting. In order to fool the Grunts, Violet donned a disguise by traveling to [[Levincia]], changing his uniform, and having his hair styled at a salon. In [[PASV15]], Violet, {{adv|Nemona}}, and Clive raided the [[Schedar Squad's Base]]. Due to her status as a {{pkmn|Champion}}-ranked Trainer, Nemona easily defeated the required number of Grunts in the Star Barrage much faster than Violet did. Despite this, [[Mela]] impatiently demanded the Grunts bring Violet to her, as he was the one who issued the challenge to begin with. Later, after Mela was defeated, the Grunts worried that they would be forced to leave the base and return home. In an act of kindness, Violet purchased the land the base was built on, allowing the Grunts to stay as long as they wished. In [[PASV17]], Clive interrogated some Grunts, who informed him that most members of Team Star joined to escape being mocked and bullied at school. They also explained that Team Star's recent, more aggressive behavior, was due to people who joined purely to be part of a strong organization. =====Pokémon===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Team Star Grunt |pkmn=Rellor |type1=Bug |img=Team Star Grunt Rellor Adventures.png |epnum=PASV14 |epname= |desc={{p|Rellor}} was used by a male Grunt to battle {{Violet}} in an attempt to dissuade him from raiding the [[Schedar Squad's Base]], but it was quickly defeated by Violet's {{p|Crocalor}}. Team Star, the Delinquents!!]]'', where he and a female Grunt attempted to recruit [[Penny]] into Team Star. They were both defeated by {{Violet}} and forced to flee. In ''[[PASV06|Skillful! The Mysterious Treasure Hunter!!]]'', the male Grunt and several others were seen in a flashback to when they first tried getting Penny to join them. This time, they were defeated by {{Scarlet}}. In [[PASV17]], several Navi Squad Grunts had a meeting at the [[Medali|Treasure Eatery]], unaware that Penny was also there listening in on them. They discussed how Violet had taken down both the {{t|Dark}} and {{t|Fire}} crews. Concerned that if Team Star lost another crew, people would stop fearing them, the Grunts decided to raid Team Star themselves and take it over. Penny immediately fled after hearing this, only be surrounded by the Grunts once they figured out she was eavesdropping. Before the Grunts could do something to keep Penny silent, [[Larry]] arrived to return a [[Rotom Phone]] Penny left behind. It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Scarlet ex}} expansion and the English {{TCG|Scarlet & Violet}} expansion, with artwork by [[nagimiso]]. An {{TCG|ultra rare}} version of the card with artwork by the same illustrator was also released in these sets. Both prints feature a male and female Team Star Grunt as they appear in {{g|Scarlet}}.
